what: Step 1. Treat start_date and end_date differently
title: Proposal for issue #47: open-ended condition_occurrence must be selectable without creating an end date or crashing
text: start_date required. end_date optional. proposal normalize way. Use two different contracts: required dates must validate length-1 non-missing Date optional dates may normalize .Date(NA) Example: avoids earlier mistake silently converting broken start_date NA.
code: normalizeRequiredDate <- function(x) {   out <- as.Date(x)    if (length(out) != 1 || is.na(out)) {     stop("Required date is missing or invalid", call. = FALSE)   }    out }  normalizeOptionalDate <- function(x) {   if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) {     return(as.Date(NA))   }    if (is.character(x) && length(x) == 1 && !nzchar(x)) {     return(as.Date(NA))   }    out <- as.Date(x)    if (length(out) == 0) {     return(as.Date(NA))   }    out }

what: Step 2. Sanitize the bar_end payload at the observer boundary
title: Proposal for issue #47: open-ended condition_occurrence must be selectable without creating an end date or crashing
text: crash happening D3--server boundary, boundary normalized explicitly. Instead letting observeEvent(input$bar_end) call updateDates() raw browser values, convert payload first. Example direction: important fix directly addresses observed stack trace.
code: normalizeBarEndPayload <- function(update_data) {   list(     person_id = update_data$person_id,     event_id = update_data$event_id,     type = update_data$type,     start_date = normalizeRequiredDate(update_data$start_date),     end_date = normalizeOptionalDate(update_data$end_date)   ) } observeEvent(input$bar_end, {   update_data <- normalizeBarEndPayload(input$bar_end)    cdm[[update_data$type]]$updateDates(     person_id = update_data$person_id,     event_id = update_data$event_id,     start_date = update_data$start_date,     end_date = update_data$end_date   ) })

what: Step 3. Harden updateDates() as a second line of defense
title: Proposal for issue #47: open-ended condition_occurrence must be selectable without creating an end date or crashing
text: updateDates() still defend . Example direction: key rule : updateDates() must ever assign length-1 Date, including .Date(NA) optional end date.
code: updateDates = function(person_id, event_id, start_date, end_date) {   start_date <- normalizeRequiredDate(start_date)   end_date <- normalizeOptionalDate(end_date)    name_id <- private$.tableNameId()   name_start_date <- private$.tableNameDate("start")   name_end_date <- private$.tableNameDate("end")   index_table <- which(private$.data[[name_id]] == event_id)    if (length(index_table) > 0) {     data.table::set(       private$.data,       i = index_table,       j = name_start_date,       value = start_date     )      if (length(end_date) == 1) {       data.table::set(         private$.data,         i = index_table,         j = name_end_date,         value = end_date       )     }   } }

what: Step 4. Render open-ended rows with display geometry only
title: Proposal for issue #47: open-ended condition_occurrence must be selectable without creating an end date or crashing
text: timeline still needs something clickable end_date missing. persist fake end date CDM table. Instead, derive display-fields. Example direction: rendering. underlying row must still keep end_date = NA.
code: timelineData <- cdm$getCdmDataTimeline() |>   dplyr::mutate(     end_date_missing = is.na(.data$end_date),     display_end_date = dplyr::if_else(       end_date_missing,       .data$start_date + 1,       .data$end_date     )   )

what: Step 5. Do not allow whole-bar drag or left-drag for open-ended rows
title: Proposal for issue #47: open-ended condition_occurrence must be selectable without creating an end date or crashing
text: biggest behavioral change needed proposal. open-ended row drawn short visual fallback, current handlers make actions implicitly create end date: moving whole bar dragging left handle happen. Recommended interaction model open-ended rows: row body: clickable selection whole-bar drag: disabled left-handle drag: disabled right-handle drag: optional, enabled explicitly creates first end date keeps “select row” separate “set first end date”. Example direction D3: similarly: open-ended rows, right-side interaction can one two designs: manual : user sets condition_end_date form manual right-drag: right-drag creates first end date explicitly Either acceptable, proposal choose one explicitly. safer initial fix manual entry .
code: function isOpenEnded(d) {   return d.end_date_missing || d.end_date == null; } g.selectAll("rect")   .data(data)   .enter()   .append("rect")   .on("click", function(event, d) {     Shiny.setInputValue("bar_start", d, {priority: "event"});   })   .each(function(d) {     if (!isOpenEnded(d)) {       d3.select(this).call(moveBar);     }   }) if (!isOpenEnded(d)) {   d3.select(this).call(elongLeft); }

what: Step 6. Make selection independent from drag completion
title: Proposal for issue #47: open-ended condition_occurrence must be selectable without creating an end date or crashing
text: plain row selection depend bar_end. Selection happen : remain valid even row real end_date. Server behavior : bar_start selects row opens tab bar_end runs permitted drag interaction separation reduces chance simple selection path triggers date mutation logic.

title: Proposal for issue #47: open-ended condition_occurrence must be selectable without creating an end date or crashing

code: normalizeBarEndPayload <- function(update_data) {   list(     person_id = update_data$person_id,     event_id = update_data$event_id,     type = update_data$type,     start_date = normalizeRequiredDate(update_data$start_date),     end_date = normalizeOptionalDate(update_data$end_date)   ) } test_that("bar_end payload with zero-length end date is normalized safely", {   payload <- normalizeBarEndPayload(list(     person_id = 1L,     event_id = 1L,     type = "condition_occurrence",     start_date = "2016-05-10",     end_date = character(0)   ))    expect_equal(payload$start_date, as.Date("2016-05-10"))   expect_equal(length(payload$end_date), 1L)   expect_true(is.na(payload$end_date)) })
